comment: Native runtime libraries linked into JIT/native builds. eavc reads this data — it carries no per-library knowledge in the compiler. A library is built (cached) and loaded only when a program references a runtimeBinding symbol matching one of its `provides` prefixes. R-018: link inputs are platform-scoped. Top-level `sources`/`include`/`defines`/`libs` are the cross-platform base; `platforms.<name>` (windows|linux|macos|wasi) adds host-specific entries, and `compiler.<driver>` (gnu|clang|msvc|zig) adds driver-specific overlays. The resolver `_resolve_runtime_links(library, platform)` merges base + platform + compiler WITHOUT compiling, so non-Windows builds never see Windows-only libs like ws2_32 (R-013).

linux.comment: R-018: SQLite on Unix links pthread/dl/math; expressed here so the resolver can surface Unix-only link inputs that a Windows build must never see.

macos.comment: R-018: macOS SQLite links the math + dynamic-loader libs; pthread is provided by libSystem but kept explicit for parity with the Linux profile.

windows.comment: R-013: Winsock (ws2_32) is required for sockets on Windows only; POSIX hosts must NOT receive -lws2_32 or the link fails.
